scripts.build: npm run build -w @bndynet/ichat-messages && npm run build -w @bndynet/ichat-input && npm run build -w @bndynet/ichat-renderers && npm run build -w @bndynet/ichat-renderer-chart && npm run build -w @bndynet/ichat-renderer-katex && npm run build -w @bndynet/ichat-renderer-mermaid && npm run build -w @bndynet/ichat && npm run build -w apps/demo
scripts.test: npm run test -w @bndynet/ichat-messages && npm run test -w @bndynet/ichat-input && npm run test -w @bndynet/ichat
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w @bndynet/ichat-messages && npm run test:coverage -w @bndynet/ichat-input
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/chat-messages/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/chat-input/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/chat/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/chat-renderers/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/chat-renderer-chart/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/chat-renderer-katex/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/chat-renderer-mermaid/tsconfig.json
scripts.dev: concurrently -n messages,input,renderers,chart,katex,mermaid,chat,demo -c cyan,magenta,yellow,green,blue,red,white,gray "npm run dev -w @bndynet/ichat-messages" "npm run dev -w @bndynet/ichat-input" "npm run dev -w @bndynet/ichat-renderers" "npm run dev -w @bndynet/ichat-renderer-chart" "npm run dev -w @bndynet/ichat-renderer-katex" "npm run dev -w @bndynet/ichat-renderer-mermaid" "npm run dev -w @bndynet/ichat" "npm run dev -w chat-demo"
scripts.publish:packages: npm run build && npm publish -w @bndynet/ichat-messages --access public && npm publish -w @bndynet/ichat-input --access public && npm publish -w @bndynet/ichat-renderers --access public && npm publish -w @bndynet/ichat-renderer-chart --access public && npm publish -w @bndynet/ichat-renderer-katex --access public && npm publish -w @bndynet/ichat-renderer-mermaid --access public && npm publish -w @bndynet/ichat --access public
